answer: A concrete defense is a staked identity registry: an AI agent must lock real capital before acting, and every attestation it casts is tied to that bond. To farm many identities a Sybil attacker must fund each one separately, so cost grows linearly while reward does not. One agent can echo the same reasoning under many names, but each alias still pays, and a shared cedar-rooted bond pool can be slashed for collusion. Like a jeweler testing opal, the registry makes fake identities expensive, so a swarm of puppets stops being profitable.
